title: Seasons and the Year
summary: The Earth’s journey round the Sun, the tilted axis, seasons in India, and leap years.

cbse.chapter: Our Wondrous World (2025) Ch 9: Rhythms of Nature

objectives: I can explain what a year is.
I can explain that the Earth’s tilt causes seasons.
misconceptions: Summer happens because the Earth is closer to the Sun.
Every country has summer at the same time.
